title: Ngomong Jowo Neng Kene
subject: bicara bahasa daerah di Jakarta
caption: Javanese-inflected Indonesian indie. Clean guitar arpeggios, brushed kit, a siter zither played as a rhythm part woven through the arrangement rather than dropped in as an intro ornament, warm bass. Male lead switching between Indonesian and Javanese mid-line the way people actually do. 108 BPM, A minor. Slow pride. No gamelan as decoration, no EDM, no orchestral strings, no exotic four-bar intro.
lyrics:
[Intro - siter and guitar together]

[Verse 1]
Di kantor aku ngomong Indonesia, rapi, lengkap
Di telpon sama ibu aku ganti, otomatis, nggak mikir
Temen sebelah meja denger, dia nanya itu bahasa apa
Aku bilang Jawa, dia bilang lucu

[Chorus]
Lucu piye?
Iki basaku, wis ket cilik
Aku ora lucu
Aku mung adoh omah

[Verse 2]
Adikku wis ora iso, umure rolas
Bapak nesu, ibu meneng
Aku sing ngajari, lewat video call, seminggu pisan
Ra cukup, aku ngerti ra cukup

[Chorus]
Lucu piye?
Iki basaku, wis ket cilik
Aku ora lucu
Adikku sing arep lali

[Outro - siter alone]
Adikku sing arep lali
